testing\n *\n * This provides a simple in-memory store for users, projects, and API keys.\n * In production, this would be replaced with PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM.\n */\n\nimport { randomBytes, scryptSync, timingSafeEqual, createHmac } from 'crypto';\n\n// Constants for cryptographic operations\nconst SALT_BYTES = 16;\nconst HASH_LENGTH = 64;\nconst PASSWORD_HASH_PARTS = 2;\nconst ID_BYTES = 16;\nconst API_KEY_BYTES = 32;\nconst TOKEN_EXPIRY_MS = 86_400_000; // 24 hours in milliseconds\n\nexport interface User {\n  id: string;\n  email: string;\n  name: string;\n  passwordHash: string;\n  tier: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface Project {\n  id: string;\n  userId: string;\n  title: string;\n  author: string | null;\n  language: 'pt-BR' | 'en';\n  genre: string | null;\n  status: 'draft' | 'queued' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed';\n  metadata: Record<"+"string, unknown>;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ApiKey {\n  id: string;\n  userId: string;\n  key: string;\n  name: string;\n  scopes: string[];\n  createdAt: string;\n  lastUsedAt: string | null;\n}\n\ninterface Session {\n  userId: string;\n  token: string;\n  expiresAt: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * In-memory database singleton\n */\nclass Database {\n  private users: Map<"+"string, User> = new Map();\n  private projects: Map<"+"string, Project> = new Map();\n  private apiKeys: Map<"+"string, ApiKey> = new Map();\n  private sessions: Map<"+"string, Session> = new Map();\n  private readonly jwtSecret: string;\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize the database with JWT secret configuration\n   */\n  constructor() {\n    // Use environment variable for JWT secret in production, or a secure default for development\n    this.jwtSecret =\n      process.env['JWT_SECRET'] ||\n      'development-secret-change-in-production-min-32-chars';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Hash password using scrypt\n   * @param password - The plaintext password to hash\n   * @returns The hashed password in format \"salt:hash\"\n   */\n  hashPassword(password: string): string {\n    const salt = randomBytes(SALT_BYTES).toString('hex');\n    const hash = scryptSync(password, salt, HASH_LENGTH).toString('hex');\n    return `${salt}:${hash}`;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Verify password against hash\n   * @param password - The plaintext password to verify\n   * @param storedHash - The stored hash in format \"salt:hash\"\n   * @returns True if password matches, false otherwise\n   */\n  verifyPassword(password: string, storedHash: string): boolean {\n    const parts = storedHash.split(':');\n    if (parts.length !== PASSWORD_HASH_PARTS || !parts[0] || !parts[1]) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    const salt = parts[0];\n    const hash = parts[1];\n    const hashToVerify = scryptSync(password, salt, HASH_LENGTH);\n    const hashBuffer = Buffer.from(hash, 'hex');\n    return timingSafeEqual(hashBuffer, hashToVerify);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate unique ID\n   * @returns A random hex string ID\n   */\n  private generateId(): string {\n    return randomBytes(ID_BYTES).toString('hex');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate JWT-like token with proper HMAC signature\n   * @returns A JWT-like token string\n   */\n  generateToken(): string {\n    const header = Buffer.from(\n      JSON.stringify({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' })\n    ).toString('base64url');\n    const payload = Buffer.from(\n      JSON.stringify({ iat: Date.now(), exp: Date.now() + TOKEN_EXPIRY_MS })\n    ).toString('base64url');\n\n    // Use proper HMAC signature instead of random bytes\n    const signature = createHmac('sha256', this.jwtSecret)\n      .update(`${header}.${payload}`)\n      .digest('base64url');\n\n    return `${header}.${payload}.${signature}`;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate API key\n   * @returns A random base64url-encoded API key\n   */\n  generateApiKey(): string {\n    return randomBytes(API_KEY_BYTES).toString('base64url');\n  }\n\n  // User operations\n  /**\n   * Create a new user\n   * @param data - User creation data\n   * @param data.email - User's email address\n   * @param data.name - User's full name\n   * @param data.password - User's plaintext password (will be hashed)\n   * @param data.tier - User's subscription tier (defaults to 'free')\n   * @returns The created user object\n   */\n  createUser(data: {\n    email: string;\n    name: string;\n    password: string;\n    tier?: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';\n  }): User {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const user: User = {\n      id,\n      email: data.email,\n      name: data.name,\n      passwordHash: this.hashPassword(data.password),\n      tier: data.tier || 'free',\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    this.users.set(id, user);\n    return user;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get user by ID\n   * @param id - The user ID\n   * @returns The user object if found, undefined otherwise\n   */\n  getUserById(id: string): User | undefined {\n    return this.users.get(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get user by email address\n   * @param email - The user's email address\n   * @returns The user object if found, undefined otherwise\n   */\n  getUserByEmail(email: string): User | [9.71s]\n","status":"Killed","testsCompleted":1,"killedBy":["0"],"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":467},"start":{"column":73,"line":465}}}],"source":"/**\n * Custom Error Types\n *\n * Domain-specific error classes for better error handling\n */\n\nimport { HTTP_STATUS } from './constants/http-status.js';\n\n/**\n * Base application error\n */\nexport abstract class AppError extends Error {\n  abstract readonly code: string;\n  abstract readonly statusCode: number;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new application error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param cause - Original error that caused this error\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public override readonly cause?: Error\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AppError';\n\n    // Maintains proper stack trace for where our error was thrown (only available on V8)\n    if (Error.captureStackTrace) {\n      Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n  } {\n    return {\n      name: this.name,\n      code: this.code,\n      message: this.message,\n      statusCode: this.statusCode,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Validation errors\n */\nexport class ValidationError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new validation error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param field - Field that failed validation\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public readonly field?: string\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'ValidationError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    field?: string;\n  } {\n    const base = super.toJSON();\n    return this.field === undefined ? base : { ...base, field: this.field };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Authentication errors\n */\nexport class AuthenticationError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'AUTHENTICATION_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new authentication error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Authentication failed') {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AuthenticationError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Authorization errors\n */\nexport class AuthorizationError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'AUTHORIZATION_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.FORBIDDEN;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new authorization error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Access denied') {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AuthorizationError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Not found errors\n */\nexport class NotFoundError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'NOT_FOUND';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new not found error\n   * @param resource - Resource type\n   * @param identifier - Resource identifier\n   */\n  constructor(resource: string, identifier?: string) {\n    const message = identifier\n      ? `${resource} with identifier '${identifier}' not found`\n      : `${resource} not found`;\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'NotFoundError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    resource: string;\n  } {\n    return {\n      ...super.toJSON(),\n      resource: this.message.split(' with')[0] || this.message,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Conflict errors\n */\nexport class ConflictError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'CONFLICT';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new conflict error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message: string) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'ConflictError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rate limit errors\n */\nexport class RateLimitError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new rate limit error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param retryAfter - Seconds to wait before retrying\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message = 'Rate limit exceeded',\n    public readonly retryAfter?: number\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'RateLimitError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    retryAfter?: number;\n  } {\n    const base = super.toJSON();\n    return this.retryAfter === undefined\n      ? base\n      : { ...base, retryAfter: this.retryAfter };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Internal server errors\n */\nexport class InternalServerError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new internal server error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param cause - Original error\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Internal server error', cause?: Error) {\n    super(message, cause);\n    this.name = 'InternalServerError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Database errors\n */\nexport class DatabaseError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'DATABASE_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new database error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param operation - Database operation that failed\n   * @param cause - Original error\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public readonly operation?: string,\n    cause?: Error\n  ) {\n    super(message, cause);\n    this.name = 'DatabaseError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    operation?: string;\n  } {\n    const base = super.toJSON();\n    return this.operation === undefined\n      ? base\n      : { ...base, operation: this.operation };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Service unavailable errors\n */\nexport class ServiceUnavailableError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new service unavailable error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Service temporarily unavailable') {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'ServiceUnavailableError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Error factory for creating appropriate error instances\n */\nexport class ErrorFactory {\n  /**\n   * Creates an appropriate error from unknown error\n   * @param error - Unknown error\n   * @returns AppError instance\n   */\n  static fromError(error: unknown): AppError {\n    if (error instanceof AppError) {\n      return error;\n    }\n\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      return ErrorFactory.createErrorFromMessage(error.message, error);\n    }\n\n    return new InternalServerError('An unexpected error occurred');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates an error based on error message analysis\n   * @param message - *\n * Implements repository interfaces using the existing in-memory database\n */\n\nimport { randomBytes } from 'crypto';\nimport { injectable } from 'tsyringe';\nimport { CRYPTO } from '../constants/crypto.js';\nimport type { User, Project, ApiKey, Session } from '../types/entities';\n\n// Service interfaces\nexport interface PasswordHasher {\n  hash: (password: string) => string;\n}\n\nexport interface TokenGenerator {\n  generate: () => string;\n}\n\nexport interface ApiKeyGenerator {\n  generate: () => string;\n}\n\n// Request types\nexport interface CreateUserRequest {\n  email: string;\n  name: string;\n  password: string;\n  tier?: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';\n}\n\nexport interface CreateProjectRequest {\n  userId: string;\n  title: string;\n  author?: string;\n  language?: 'pt-BR' | 'en';\n  genre?: string;\n  status?: 'draft' | 'queued' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed';\n  metadata?: Record<"+"string, unknown>;\n}\n\nexport interface CreateApiKeyRequest {\n  userId: string;\n  name: string;\n  scopes: string[];\n}\n\n// Repository interfaces\nexport interface UserRepository {\n  createUser: (userData: CreateUserRequest) => Promise<"+"User>;\n  findByEmail: (email: string) => Promise<"+"User | null>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"User | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\nexport interface ProjectRepository {\n  createProject: (data: CreateProjectRequest) => Promise<"+"Project>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"Project | null>;\n  findByUserId: (userId: string) => Promise<"+"Project[]>;\n  update: (id: string, data: Partial<"+"Project>) => Promise<"+"Project | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\nexport interface ApiKeyRepository {\n  createApiKey: (data: CreateApiKeyRequest) => Promise<"+"ApiKey>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"ApiKey | null>;\n  findByKey: (key: string) => Promise<"+"ApiKey | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\nexport interface SessionRepository {\n  createSession: (userId: string) => Promise<"+"string>;\n  findByToken: (token: string) => Promise<"+"Session | null>;\n  delete: (token: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\n/**\n * In-memory database repository implementation\n */\n@injectable()\nexport class DatabaseRepository {\n  private users: Map<"+"string, User> = new Map();\n  private projects: Map<"+"string, Project> = new Map();\n  private apiKeys: Map<"+"string, ApiKey> = new Map();\n  private sessions: Map<"+"string, Session> = new Map();\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new DatabaseRepository instance\n   * @param passwordHasher - Service for hashing passwords\n   * @param tokenGenerator - Service for generating tokens\n   * @param apiKeyGenerator - Service for generating API keys\n   */\n  constructor(\n    private passwordHasher: PasswordHasher,\n    private tokenGenerator: TokenGenerator,\n    private apiKeyGenerator: ApiKeyGenerator\n  ) {}\n\n  // Helper method to generate IDs\n  /**\n   * Generates a unique identifier using random bytes\n   * @returns Generated ID as hexadecimal string\n   */\n  private generateId(): string {\n    return randomBytes(CRYPTO.ID_BYTES).toString('hex');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Gets the current timestamp in ISO format\n   * @returns Current timestamp as ISO string\n   */\n  private getCurrentTimestamp(): string {\n    return new Date().toISOString();\n  }\n\n  // UserRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new user in the database\n   * @param userData - User data to create\n   * @returns Created user object\n   */\n  async createUser(userData: CreateUserRequest): Promise<"+"User> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const user: User = {\n      id,\n      email: userData.email,\n      name: userData.name,\n      passwordHash: this.passwordHasher.hash(userData.password),\n      tier: userData.tier || 'free',\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    this.users.set(id, user);\n    return user;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a user by email address\n   * @param email - Email address to search for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return (\n      Array.from(this.users.values()).find((user) => user.email === email) ||\n      null\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a user by ID\n   * @param id - User ID to search for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findUserById(id: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return this.users.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a user by ID\n   * @param id - User ID to delete\n   * @returns True if user was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteUser(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.users.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // ProjectRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new project in the database\n   * @param data - Project data to create\n   * @returns Created project object\n   */\n  async createProject(data: CreateProjectRequest): Promise<"+"Project> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const project: Project = {\n      id,\n      userId: data.userId,\n      title: data.title,\n      author: data.author || null,\n      language: data.language || 'pt-BR',\n      genre: data.genre || null,\n      status: data.status || 'draft',\n      metadata: data.metadata || {},\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    this.projects.set(id, project);\n    return project;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a project by ID\n   * @param id - Project ID to search for\n   * @returns Project object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findProjectById(id: string): Promise<"+"Project | null> {\n    return this.projects.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds all projects for a specific user\n   * @param userId - User ID to search projects for\n   * @returns Array of projects belonging to the user\n   */\n  async findProjectsByUserId(userId: string): Promise<"+"Project[]> {\n    return Array.from(this.projects.values()).filter(\n      (project) => project.userId === userId\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Updates a project with new data\n   * @param id - Project ID to update\n   * @param data - Partial project data to update\n   * @returns Updated project object or null if not found\n   */\n  async updateProject(\n    id: string,\n    data: Partial<"+"Project>\n  ): Promise<"+"Project | null> {\n    const project = this.projects.get(id);\n    if (!project) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    const updated: Project = {\n      ...project,\n      ...data,\n      updatedAt: this.getCurrentTimestamp(),\n    };\n    this.projects.set(id, updated);\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a project by ID\n   * @param id - Project ID to delete\n   * @returns True if project was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteProject(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.projects.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // ApiKeyRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new API key in the database\n   * @param data - API key data to create\n   * @returns Created API key object\n   */\n  async createApiKey(data: CreateApiKeyRequest): Promise<"+"ApiKey> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const key = this.apiKeyGenerator.generate();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const apiKey: ApiKey = {\n      id,\n      userId: data.userId,\n      key,\n      name: data.name,\n      scopes: data.scopes,\n      createdAt: now,\n      lastUsedAt: null,\n    };\n    this.apiKeys.set(id, apiKey);\n    return apiKey;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds an API key by ID\n   * @param id - API key ID to search for\n   * @returns API key object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findApiKeyById(id: string): Promise<"+"ApiKey | null> {\n    return this.apiKeys.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds an API key by the actual key value\n   * @param key - API key value to search for\n   * @returns API key object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findApiKeyByKey(key: string): Promise<"+"ApiKey | null> {\n    return (\n      Array.from(this.apiKeys.values()).find((ak) => ak.key === key) || null\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes an API key by ID\n   * @param id - API key ID to delete\n   * @returns True if API key was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteApiKey(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.apiKeys.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // SessionRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new session for a user\n   * @param userId - User ID to create session for\n   * @returns Generated session token\n   */\n  async createSession(userId: string): Promise<"+"string> {\n    const token = this.tokenGenerator.generate();\n    const expiresAt = new Date(\n      Date.now() + CRYPTO.SESSION_DURATION_MS\n    ).toISOString(); // 24 hours\n    this.sessions.set(token, { userId, token, expiresAt });\n    return token;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a session by token\n   * @param token - Session token to search for\n   * @returns Session object or null if not found or expired\n   */\n  async findSessionByToken(token: string): Promise<"+"Session | null> {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(token);\n    if (!session) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    // Check expiration\n    if (new Date(session.expiresAt) <"+" new Date()) {\n      this.sessions.delete(token);\n      return null;\n    }\n    return session;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a session by token\n   * @param token - Session token to delete\n   * @returns True if session was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteSession(token: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.sessions.delete(token);\n  }\n\n  // Additional convenience methods for testing\n  /**\n   * Gets a user by session token\n   * @param token - Session token to find user for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async getUserByToken(token: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    const session = await this.findSessionByToken(token);\n    if (!session) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return this.findUserById(session.userId);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Gets a user by API key\n   * @param apiKey - API key to find user for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async getUserByApiKey(apiKey: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    const key = await this.findApiKeyByKey(apiKey);\n    if (!key) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return this.findUserById(key.userId);\n  }\n\n  // Clear all data (for testing)\n  /**\n   * Clears all data from all repositories\n   */\n  clear(): void {\n    this.users.clear();\n    this.projects.clear();\n    this.apiKeys.clear();\n    this.sessions.clear();\n  }\n}\n"},"src/repositories/in-memory-api-key-repository.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"347","mutatorName":"BlockStatement","replacement":"{}","statusReason":"bun test v1.3.0 database: Database) {}\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param userData\n   */\n  async create(userData: CreateUserRequest): Promise<"+"User> {\n    return this.database.createUser(userData);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param id\n   */\n  async findById(id: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return this.database.getUserById(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param email\n   */\n  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return this.database.getUserByEmail(email) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param id\n   */\n  async delete(id: string): The voice ID to search for\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice | null> - The voice if found, null otherwise\n   */\n  async findById(id: string): Promise<"+"Voice | null> {\n    return this.voices.get(id) ?? null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get all voices in the repository\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice[]> - Array of all voices\n   */\n  async findAll(): Promise<"+"Voice[]> {\n    return Array.from(this.voices.values());\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Find voices by provider\n   * @param provider - The provider name to filter by\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice[]> - Array of voices from the specified provider\n   */\n  async findByProvider(provider: string): Promise<"+"Voice[]> {\n    return Array.from(this.voices.values()).filter(\n      (voice: Voice): boolean => voice.provider === provider\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Find all available voices\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice[]> - Array of available voices\n   */\n  async findAvailable(): Promise<"+"Voice[]> {\n    return Array.from(this.voices.values()).filter(\n      (voice: Voice): boolean => voice.isAvailable\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Save a voice to the repository\n   * @param voice - The voice to save\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice> - The saved voice\n   */\n  async save(voice: Voice): Promise<"+"Voice> {\n    this.voices.set(voice.id, voice);\n    return voice;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Delete a voice by its ID\n   * @param id - The voice ID to delete\n   * @returns Promise<"+"boolean> - True if the voice was deleted, false if not found\n   */\n  async delete(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.voices.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update a voice with partial data\n   * @param id - The voice ID to update\n   * @param updates - Partial voice data to merge\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice | null> - The updated voice if found, null otherwise\n   */\n  async update(id: string, updates: Partial<"+"Voice>): Promise<"+"Voice | null> {\n    const voice = this.voices.get(id);\n    if (!voice) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const updatedVoice: Voice = {\n      ...voice,\n      ...updates,\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    this.voices.set(id, updatedVoice);\n    return updatedVoice;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Find voices by language (exact match or partial match)\n   * @param language - The language code to search for\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice[]> - Array of voices matching the language\n   */\n  async findByLanguage(language: string): Promise<"+"Voice[]> {\n    return Array.from(this.voices.values()).filter(\n      (voice: Voice): boolean =>\n        voice.language === language || voice.language.includes(language)\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Find the default voice\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice | null> - The default voice if found, null otherwise\n   */\n  async findDefault(): Promise<"+"Voice | null> {\n    const defaultVoices = Array.from(this.voices.values()).filter(\n      (voice: Voice): boolean => voice.isDefault\n    );\n\n    return defaultVoices.length > 0 ? (defaultVoices[0] ?? null) : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Seed the repository with initial voice data\n   */\n  private seedInitialData(): void {\n    const voices = DEFAULT_VOICE_CONFIGS.map(\n      (config: VoiceConfig): Voice => this.createVoiceFromConfig(config)\n    );\n\n    for (const voice of voices) {\n      this.voices.set(voice.id, voice);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a voice object from configuration\n   * @param config - Voice configuration\n   * @returns Voice - Created voice object\n   */\n  private createVoiceFromConfig(config: VoiceConfig): Voice {\n    const now = new Date();\n    return {\n      id: config.id,\n      name: config.name,\n      language: config.language,\n      gender: config.gender,\n      age: config.age,\n      provider: 'openai',\n      providerId: config.id,\n      isActive: true,\n      isAvailable: config.isAvailable ?? true,\n      isDefault: config.isDefault ?? false,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear all data (useful for testing)\n   */\n  clear(): void {\n    this.voices.clear();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get current data size\n   * @returns number - Number of voices in the }\n}\n"},"src/repositories/user-repository.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"609","mutatorName":"BlockStatement","replacement":"{}","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":44},"start":{"column":32,"line":42}}},{"id":"610","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":55,"line":43},"start":{"column":50,"line":43}}},{"id":"611","mutatorName":"BlockStatement","replacement":"{}","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":52},"start":{"column":41,"line":50}}},{"id":"612","mutatorName":"BlockStatement","replacement":"{}","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":73},"start":{"column":64,"line":59}}},{"id":"613","mutatorName":"ObjectLiteral","replacement":"{}","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":6,"line":70},"start":{"column":24,"line":62}}},{"id":"614","mutatorName":"ConditionalExpression","replacement":"true","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":36,"line":67},"start":{"column":13,"line":67}}},{"id":"615","mutatorName":"ConditionalExpression","replacement":"false","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":36,"line":67},"start":{"column":13,"line":67}}},{"id":"616","mutatorName":"LogicalOperator","replacement":"userData.tier * User Repository Implementation\n */\n\nimport { randomBytes } from 'crypto';\nimport { injectable } from 'tsyringe';\nimport { CRYPTO } from '../constants/crypto.js';\nimport type { User } from '../types/entities';\nimport type { PasswordHasher } from './database-repository';\n\nexport interface CreateUserRequest {\n  email: string;\n  name: string;\n  password: string;\n  tier?: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';\n}\n\nexport interface UserRepository {\n  createUser: (userData: CreateUserRequest) => Promise<"+"User>;\n  findByEmail: (email: string) => Promise<"+"User | null>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"User | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\n/**\n * In-memory user repository implementation\n */\n@injectable()\nexport class UserRepositoryImpl implements UserRepository {\n  private users: Map<"+"string, User> = new Map();\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new UserRepositoryImpl instance\n   * @param passwordHasher - Service for hashing passwords\n   */\n  constructor(private passwordHasher: PasswordHasher) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Generates a unique identifier using random bytes\n   * @returns Generated ID as hexadecimal string\n   */\n  private generateId(): string {\n    return randomBytes(CRYPTO.ID_BYTES).toString('hex');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Gets the current timestamp in ISO format\n   * @returns Current timestamp as ISO string\n   */\n  private getCurrentTimestamp(): string {\n    return new Date().toISOString();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new user in the database\n   * @param userData - User data to create\n   * @returns Created user object\n   */\n  async createUser(userData: CreateUserRequest): Promise<"+"User> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const user: User = {\n      id,\n      email: userData.email,\n      name: userData.name,\n      passwordHash: this.passwordHasher.hash(userData.password),\n      tier: userData.tier || 'free',\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    this.users.set(id, user);\n    return user;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a user by email address\n   * @param email - Email address to search for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return (\n      Array.from(this.users.values()).find((user) => user.email === email) ||\n      null\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a user by ID\n   * @param id - User ID to search for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findById(id: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return this.users.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a user by ID\n   * @param id - User ID to delete\n   * @returns True if user was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async delete(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.users.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // Clear all data (for testing)\n  /**\n   * Clears all user data from the repository\n   */\n  clear(): void {\n    this.users.clear();\n  }\n}\n"},"src/routes/auth.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"632","mutatorName":"BlockStatement","replacement":"{}","statusReason":"bun test v1.3.0 error: 'API key not found', status: 404 };\n  }\n\n  // Check authorization - only owner can delete their API keys\n  if (apiKey.userId !== authUser.id) {\n    return { error: 'Forbidden', status: 403 'Valid email is required' };\n      }\n\n      // Validate required fields\n      if (!body.name || !body.password) {\n        set.status = 400;\n        return { error: 'Missing required fields: name, password' };\n      }\n\n      // Check for duplicate email\n      const existingUser = db.getUserByEmail(body.email);\n      if (existingUser) {\n        set.status = 409;\n        return { error: 'User with this email already exists' };\n      }\n\n      // Create user\n      const user = db.createUser({\n        email: body.email,\n        name: body.name,\n        password: body.password,\n        ...(body.tier && { tier: body.tier }),\n      });\n\n      set.status = 201;\n      return {\n        id: user.id,\n        email: user.email,\n        name: user.name,\n        tier: user.tier,\n      };\n    },\n    {\n      body: t.Object({\n        email: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        name: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        password: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        tier: t.Optional(\n          t.Union([\n            t.Literal('free'),\n            t.Literal('pro'),\n            t.Literal('enterprise'),\n          ])\n        ),\n      }),\n    }\n  )\n\n  // POST /api/auth/login\n  .post(\n    '/login',\n    ({ body, set }) => {\n      // Find user\n      const user = db.getUserByEmail(body.email);\n      if (!user) {\n        set.status = 401;\n        return { error: 'Invalid credentials' };\n      }\n\n      // Verify password\n      const isValid = db.verifyPassword(body.password, user.passwordHash);\n      if (!isValid) {\n        set.status = 401;\n        return { error: 'Invalid credentials' };\n      }\n\n      // Create session\n      const token = db.createSession(user.id);\n\n      set.status = 200;\n      return { token };\n    },\n    {\n      body: t.Object({\n        email: t.String(),\n        password: t.String(),\n      }),\n    }\n  )\n\n  // GET /api/auth/me\n  .get('/me', ({ headers, set }) => {\n    const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n    if (!authUser) {\n      set.status = 401;\n      return { error: 'Unauthorized' };\n    }\n\n    set.status = 200;\n    return authUser;\n  })\n\n  // POST /api/auth/api-keys\n  .post(\n    '/api-keys',\n    ({ body, headers, set }) => {\n      const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n      if (!authUser) {\n        set.status = 401;\n        return { error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      }\n\n      const apiKey = db.createApiKey({\n        userId: authUser.id,\n        name: body.name,\n        scopes: body.scopes,\n      });\n\n      set.status = 201;\n      return {\n        id: apiKey.id,\n        key: apiKey.key,\n        name: apiKey.name,\n        scopes: apiKey.scopes,\n      };\n    },\n    {\n      body: t.Object({\n        name: t.String(),\n        scopes: t.Array(t.String()),\n      }),\n    }\n  )\n\n  // DELETE /api/auth/api-keys/:id\n  .delete('/api-keys/:id', ({ params, headers, set }) => {\n    const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n    const validation = validateApiKeyDeletion(params, authUser);\n\n    if (validation.error) {\n      set.status = validation.status || HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST;\n      return { error: validation.error };\n    }\n\n    const deleted = db.deleteApiKey(params.id);\n    if (!deleted) {\n      set.status = 404;\n      return { error: 'API key not found' };\n    }\n    set.status = 204;\n    return null;\n  });\n"},"src/routes/projects.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"763","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","statusReason":"bun test v1.3.0 { Elysia, t } from 'elysia';\nimport { db } from '../database';\nimport { extractAuthUser } from '../utils/auth';\n\nconst ERROR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND = 'Project not found';\n\n// HTTP status codes\nconst HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST = 400;\n\n/**\n * Validate and authorize project deletion\n * @param params - The route parameters containing the project ID\n * @param params.id - The ID of the project to delete\n * @param authUser - The authenticated user object\n * @param authUser.id - The ID of the authenticated user\n * @returns Validation result with error and status if validation fails\n */\nfunction validateProjectDeletion(\n  params: { id: string },\n  authUser: { id: string } | null\n): { error?: string; status?: number } {\n  if (!authUser) {\n    return { error: 'Unauthorized', status: 401 };\n  }\n\n  const project = db.getProjectById(params.id);\n  if (!project) {\n    return { error: ERROR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, status: 404 };\n  }\n\n  // Check authorization - only owner can delete\n  if (project.userId !== authUser.id) {\n    return { error: 'Forbidden', status: 403 };\n  }\n\n  return {};\n}\n\nexport const projectRoutes = new Elysia({ prefix: '/api/projects' })\n  // GET /api/projects\n  .get('/', ({ headers, set }) => {\n    const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n    if (!authUser) {\n      set.status = 401;\n      return { error: 'Unauthorized' };\n    }\n\n    const projects = db.getProjectsByUserId(authUser.id);\n    set.status = 200;\n    return projects;\n  })\n\n  // POST /api/projects\n  .post(\n    '/',\n    ({ body, headers, set }) => {\n      const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n      if (!authUser) {\n        set.status = 401;\n        return { error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      }\n\n      // Validate required fields\n      if (!body.title) {\n        set.status = 400;\n        return { error: 'Missing required field: title' };\n      }\n\n      const project = db.createProject({\n        userId: authUser.id,\n        title: body.title,\n        ...(body.author && { author: body.author }),\n        ...(body.language && { language: body.language }),\n        ...(body.genre && { genre: body.genre }),\n        ...(body.status && { status: body.status }),\n        ...(body.metadata && { metadata: body.metadata }),\n      });\n\n      set.status = 201;\n      return project;\n    },\n    {\n      body: t.Object({\n        title: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        author: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        language: t.Optional(t.Union([t.Literal('pt-BR'), t.Literal('en')])),\n        genre: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        status: t.Optional(\n          t.Union([\n            t.Literal('draft'),\n            t.Literal('queued'),\n            t.Literal('processing'),\n            t.Literal('completed'),\n            t.Literal('failed'),\n          ])\n        ),\n        metadata: t.Optional(t.Record(t.String(), t.Any())),\n      }),\n    }\n  )\n\n  // GET /api/projects/:id\n  .get('/:id', ({ params, headers, set }) => {\n    const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n    if (!authUser) {\n      set.status = 401;\n      return { error: 'Unauthorized' };\n    }\n\n    const project = db.getProjectById(params.id);\n    if (!project) {\n      set.status = 404;\n      return { error: ERROR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND };\n    }\n\n    // Check authorization\n    if (project.userId !== authUser.id) {\n      set.status = 403;\n      return { error: 'Forbidden' };\n    }\n\n    set.status = 200;\n    return project;\n  })\n\n  // PATCH /api/projects/:id\n  .patch(\n    '/:id',\n    ({ params, body, headers, set }) => {\n      const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n      if (!authUser) {\n        set.status = 401;\n        return { error: 'Unauthorized' };\n      }\n\n      const project = db.getProjectById(params.id);\n      if (!project) {\n        set.status = 404;\n        return { error: ERROR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND };\n      }\n\n      // Check authorization\n      if (project.userId !== authUser.id) {\n        set.status = 403;\n        return { error: 'Forbidden' };\n      }\n\n      const updated = db.updateProject(params.id, body);\n      set.status = 200;\n      return updated;\n    },\n    {\n      body: t.Object({\n        title: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        author: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        language: t.Optional(t.Union([t.Literal('pt-BR'), t.Literal('en')])),\n        genre: t.Optional(t.String()),\n        status: t.Optional(\n          t.Union([\n            t.Literal('draft'),\n            t.Literal('queued'),\n            t.Literal('processing'),\n            t.Literal('completed'),\n            t.Literal('failed'),\n          ])\n        ),\n        metadata: t.Optional(t.Record(t.String(), t.Any())),\n      }),\n    }\n  )\n\n  // DELETE /api/projects/:id\n  .delete('/:id', ({ params, headers, set }) => {\n    const authUser = extractAuthUser(headers['authorization'] || null);\n    const validation = validateProjectDeletion(params, authUser);\n\n    if (validation.error) {\n      set.status = validation.status || HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST;\n      return { error: validation.error };\n    }\n\n    const deleted = db.deleteProject(params.id);\n    if (!deleted) {\n      set.status = 404;\n      return { error: { promises as fs } from 'fs';\nimport { join } from 'path';\nimport type { Storage } from '../../../core-domain/src/index.js';\n\n/**\n * Local File Storage Implementation\n *\n * This is a simple local file system implementation for development.\n * In production, this would use cloud storage like AWS S3 or similar.\n */\nexport class LocalStorage implements Storage {\n  private readonly basePath: string;\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param basePath\n   */\n  constructor(basePath = './storage') {\n    this.basePath = basePath;\n    this.ensureDirectoryExists();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   * @param data\n   */\n  async save(key: string, data: Buffer | string): Promise<"+"string> {\n    const filePath = this.getFilePath(key);\n    await this.ensureDirectoryExists();\n    await fs.writeFile(filePath, data);\n    return filePath;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   */\n  async load(key: string): Promise<"+"Buffer | null> {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.getFilePath(key);\n      return await fs.readFile(filePath);\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   */\n  async delete(key: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.getFilePath(key);\n      await fs.unlink(filePath);\n      return true;\n    } catch {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   */\n  async exists(key: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.getFilePath(key);\n      await fs.access(filePath);\n      return true;\n    } catch {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   */\n  async getUrl(key: string): Promise<"+"string> {\n    // Mock implementation - return file path as URL\n    return `file://${this.getFilePath(key)}`;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param prefix\n   */\n  async list(prefix?: string): Promise<"+"string[]> {\n    const dirPath = prefix ? join(this.basePath, prefix) : this.basePath;\n    try {\n      const files = await fs.readdir(dirPath, { recursive: true });\n      return files\n        .filter((file) => typeof file === 'string')\n        .map((file) => file.replace(/^.*\\//, '')); // Remove path prefix\n    } catch {\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   */\n  async getMetadata(key: string): Promise<"+"Record<"+"string, unknown> | null> {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.getFilePath(key);\n      const stats = await fs.stat(filePath);\n      return {\n        size: stats.size,\n        lastModified: stats.mtime,\n        created: stats.birthtime,\n        isDirectory: stats.isDirectory(),\n        isFile: stats.isFile(),\n      };\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param sourceKey\n   * @param destinationKey\n   */\n  async copy(sourceKey: string, destinationKey: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    try {\n      const sourcePath = this.getFilePath(sourceKey);\n      const destinationPath = this.getFilePath(destinationKey);\n      await this.ensureDirectoryExists();\n      await fs.copyFile(sourcePath, destinationPath);\n      return true;\n    } catch {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param sourceKey\n   * @param destinationKey\n   */\n  async move(sourceKey: string, destinationKey: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    if (await this.copy(sourceKey, destinationKey)) {\n      return this.delete(sourceKey);\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param key\n   */\n  private getFilePath(key: string): string {\n    // Sanitize key to prevent directory traversal\n    const sanitizedKey = key.replace(/[^\\w.-]/g, '_');\n    return join(this.basePath, sanitizedKey);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  private async ensureDirectoryExists(): Promise<"+"void> {\n    try {\n      await fs.mkdir(this.basePath, { recursive: true });\n    } catch {\n      // Directory already exists or permission error\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Clear all storage (useful for testing)\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  async clear(): Promise<"+"void> {\n    try {\n      await fs.rm(this.basePath, { recursive: true, force: true });\n      await this.ensureDirectoryExists();\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore errors during cleanup\n    }\n '../../../core-domain/src/index.js';\n\n/**\n * In-Memory Queue Implementation\n *\n * This is a simple in-memory queue for development and testing.\n * In production, this would use a proper message queue like Redis, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS.\n */\ninterface QueueJob {\n  id: string;\n  job: GenerationJob;\n  createdAt: Date;\n}\n\n/**\n * In-Memory Queue Implementation\n */\nexport class MemoryQueue implements Queue {\n  private jobs: QueueJob[] = [];\n  private completedJobs: Set<"+"string> = new Set();\n  private failedJobs: Map<"+"string, string> = new Map();\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param job\n   */\n  async enqueue(job: GenerationJob): Promise<"+"void> {\n    const queueJob: QueueJob = {\n      id: job.id,\n      job,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n    };\n    this.jobs.push(queueJob);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  async dequeue(): Promise<"+"GenerationJob | null> {\n    const queueJob = this.jobs.shift();\n    return queueJob ? queueJob.job : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param jobId\n   */\n  async complete(jobId: string): Promise<"+"void> {\n    this.completedJobs.add(jobId);\n    // Remove from failed jobs if it was there\n    this.failedJobs.delete(jobId);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param jobId\n   * @param error\n   */\n  async fail(jobId: string, error: string): Promise<"+"void> {\n    this.failedJobs.set(jobId, error);\n  }\n\n  // Utility methods for testing\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  size(): number {\n    return this.jobs.length;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  getCompletedJobs(): string[] {\n    return Array.from(this.completedJobs);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  getFailedJobs(): Map<"+"string, string> {\n    return new Map(this.failedJobs);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   */\n  async clear(): Promise<"+"void> {\n    this.jobs = [];\n    this.completedJobs.clear();\n    this.failedJobs.clear();\n  }\n}\n"},"src/services/openai-tts-engine.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"1012","mutatorName":"ArrayDeclaration","replacement":"[]","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":2,"line":58},"start":{"column":46,"line":20}}},{"id":"1013","mutatorName":"ObjectLiteral","replacement":"{}","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":27},"start":{"column":3,"line":21}}},{"id":"1014","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":16,"line":22},"start":{"column":9,"line":22}}},{"id":"1015","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":18,"line":23},"start":{"column":11,"line":23}}},{"id":"1016","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":22,"line":24},"start":{"column":13,"line":24}}},{"id":"1017","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":17,"line":25},"start":{"column":10,"line":25}}},{"id":"1018","mutatorName":"BooleanLiteral","replacement":"false","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":20,"line":26},"start":{"column":16,"line":26}}},{"id":"1019","mutatorName":"ObjectLiteral","replacement":"{}","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":33},"start":{"column":3,"line":28}}},{"id":"1020","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":15,"line":29},"start":{"column":9,"line":29}}},{"id":"1021","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":17,"line":30},"start":{"column":11,"line":30}}},{"id":"1022","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","status":"Survived","testsCompleted":1,"location":{"end":{"column":19,"li '../../../core-domain/src/index.js';\n\n// Constants to avoid magic numbers\nconst DEFAULT_MOCK_DELAY_MS = 100;\n\n/**\n * Configuration for creating voice objects\n */\ninterface VoiceConfig {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  gender: 'male' | 'female' | 'neutral';\n  age: 'young' | 'adult' | 'mature';\n  isDefault?: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * Default voice configurations for OpenAI TTS\n */\nconst DEFAULT_VOICE_CONFIGS: VoiceConfig[] = [\n  {\n    id: 'alloy',\n    name: 'Alloy',\n    gender: 'neutral',\n    age: 'adult',\n    isDefault: true,\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'echo',\n    name: 'Echo',\n    gender: 'male',\n    age: 'adult',\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'fable',\n    name: 'Fable',\n    gender: 'neutral',\n    age: 'adult',\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'onyx',\n    name: 'Onyx',\n    gender: 'male',\n    age: 'mature',\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'nova',\n    name: 'Nova',\n    gender: 'female',\n    age: 'adult',\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'shimmer',\n    name: 'Shimmer',\n    gender: 'female',\n    age: 'young',\n  },\n];\n\n/**\n * OpenAI Text-to-Speech Engine Implementation\n *\n * This is a mock implementation for testing purposes.\n * In production, this would integrate with the actual OpenAI API.\n */\nexport class OpenAITTSEngine implements TTSEngine {\n  private readonly mockDelayMs = DEFAULT_MOCK_DELAY_MS;\n\n  /**\n   * Generate audio from text using the specified voice\n   * @param text - The text to synthesize\n   * @param voice - The voice to use for synthesis\n   * @returns Promise<"+"ArrayBuffer> - The generated audio data\n   */\n  async generate(text: string, voice: Voice): Promise<"+"ArrayBuffer> {\n    // Mock implementation - return empty buffer for testing\n    // In production, this would call OpenAI's TTS API\n    console.log(`[Mock TTS] Synthesizing \"${text}\" with voice \"${voice.name}\"`);\n\n    // Simulate API delay\n    await new Promise<"+"void>((resolve: () => void): void => {\n      setTimeout(resolve, this.mockDelayMs);\n    });\n\n    // Return mock audio buffer as ArrayBuffer\n    const encoder = new TextEncoder();\n    const uint8Array = encoder.encode('mock-audio-data');\n    const arrayBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(uint8Array.length);\n    const view = new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer);\n    view.set(uint8Array);\n    return arrayBuffer;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get available voices from OpenAI\n   * @returns Promise<"+"Voice[]> - Array of available voices\n   */\n  async getVoices(): Promise<"+"Voice[]> {\n    return DEFAULT_VOICE_CONFIGS.map(\n      (config: VoiceConfig): Voice => this.createVoice(config)\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a voice object from configuration\n   * @param config - Voice configuration\n   * @returns Voice - The created voice object\n   */\n  private createVoice(config: VoiceConfig): Voice {\n    const now = new Date();\n    return {\n      id: config.id,\n      name: config.name,\n      language: 'en-US',\n      gender: config.gender,\n      age: config.age,\n      provider: 'openai',\n      providerId: config.id,\n      isActive: true,\n      isAvailable: true,\n      isDefault: config.isDefault ?? false,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate if a voice ID is available\n   * @param voiceId - The voice ID to validate\n   * @returns Promise<"+"boolean> - True if the voice is available\n   */\n  async validateVoice(voiceId: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    const availableVoices = await this.getVoices();\n    return availableVoices.some(\n      (voice: Voice): boolean => voice.id === voiceId\n    );\n  }\n}\n"},"src/services/random-api-key-generator.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"1064","mutatorName":"StringLiteral","replacement":"\"\"","statusReason":"bun test v1.3.0 * Test Data Factories\n *\n * Factory functions for creating test data with proper validation\n */\n\nimport { faker } from '@faker-js/faker';\n\n// Constants for test data\nconst TEST_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 16;\nconst TEST_PASSWORDS_COUNT = 7;\n\n// Constants for test data generation\nconst DEFAULT_TITLE_WORD_COUNT = 3;\nconst DEFAULT_GENRE_WORD_COUNT = 2;\n\n// Type aliases\ntype UserTier = 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';\ntype ProjectLanguage = 'pt-BR' | 'en';\ntype ProjectStatus = 'draft' | 'queued' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed';\n\n// Factory data types\nexport interface UserFactoryData {\n  email: string;\n  name: string;\n  password: string;\n  tier: UserTier;\n}\n\nexport interface ProjectFactoryData {\n  userId: string;\n  title: string;\n  author?: string | null;\n  language: ProjectLanguage;\n  genre?: string | null;\n  status: ProjectStatus;\n  metadata?: Record<"+"string, unknown>;\n}\n\n// Validation helpers\n/**\n *\n * @param email\n */\nfunction validateEmail(email: unknown): string {\n  if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {\n    throw new Error('Email must be a non-empty string');\n  }\n\n  if (!email.includes('@')) {\n    throw new Error('Email must contain @ symbol');\n  }\n\n  return email;\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param name\n */\nfunction validateName(name: unknown): string {\n  if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') {\n    throw new Error('Name must be a non-empty string');\n  }\n\n  if (name.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error('Name cannot be empty');\n  }\n\n  return name;\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param password\n */\nfunction validatePassword(password: unknown): string {\n  if (!password || typeof password !== 'string') {\n    throw new Error('Password must be a non-empty string');\n  }\n\n  if (password.length !== TEST_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `Password must be exactly ${TEST_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters`\n    );\n  }\n\n  return password;\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param tier\n */\nfunction validateTier(tier: unknown): UserTier {\n  const validTiers: UserTier[] = ['free', 'pro', 'enterprise'];\n  if (!validTiers.includes(tier as UserTier)) {\n    throw new Error('Tier must be one of: free, pro, enterprise');\n  }\n\n  return tier as UserTier;\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param value\n * @param fieldName\n */\nfunction validateStringField(value: unknown, fieldName: string): string {\n  if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') {\n    throw new Error(`${fieldName} must be a non-empty string`);\n  }\n\n  if (value.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error(`${fieldName} cannot be empty`);\n  }\n\n  return value;\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param author\n */\nfunction validateAuthorField(author: unknown): void {\n  if (author !== null) {\n    validateStringField(author, 'Author');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param language\n */\nfunction validateLanguage(language: ProjectLanguage): void {\n  const validLanguages: ProjectLanguage[] = ['pt-BR', 'en'];\n  if (!validLanguages.includes(language)) {\n    throw new Error('Language must be one of: pt-BR, en');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n *\n * @param data\n */\nfunction validateProjectData(data: ProjectFactoryData): void {\n  validateStringField(data.userId, 'User ID');\n  validateStringField(data.title, 'Title');\n  validateAuthorField(data.author);\n  validateLanguage(data.language);\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates test user data with validation\n * @param overrides - Optional overrides for user data\n * @returns Complete user data with all required fields\n */\nexport function createTestUser(\n  overrides: Partial<"+"UserFactoryData> = {}\n): Required<"+"UserFactoryData> {\n  const userData = {\n    email: faker.internet.email(),\n    name: faker.person.fullName(),\n    password: faker.internet.password({ length: TEST_PASSWORD_LENGTH }),\n    tier: 'free' as UserTier,\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n\n  return {\n    email: validateEmail(userData.email),\n    name: validateName(userData.name),\n    password: validatePassword(userData.password),\n    tier: validateTier(userData.tier),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates test project data with validation\n * @param overrides - Optional overrides for project data\n * @returns Complete project data with all required fields\n */\nexport function createTestProject(\n  overrides: Partial<"+"ProjectFactoryData> = {}\n): Required<"+"ProjectFactoryData> {\n  const projectData = {\n    userId: faker.string.uuid(),\n    title: faker.lorem.words(DEFAULT_TITLE_WORD_COUNT),\n    author: faker.person.fullName(),\n    language: 'pt-BR' as ProjectLanguage,\n    genre: faker.lorem.words(DEFAULT_GENRE_WORD_COUNT),\n    status: 'draft' as ProjectStatus,\n    metadata: {},\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n\n  validateProjectData(projectData);\n\n  return {\n    userId: projectData.userId,\n    title: projectData.title,\n    author: projectData.author || null,\n    language: projectData.language,\n    genre: projectData.genre || null,\n    status: projectData.status,\n    metadata: projectData.metadata || {},\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Test passwords for authentication tests (static, deterministic)\n */\nexport const TEST_PASSWORDS = {\n  VALID_USER: 'valid1234567890ab',\n  VALID_PRO: 'pro1234567890abcd',\n  VALID_ENTERPRISE: 'enterprise1234567',\n  ADMIN: 'admin1234567890ab',\n  INVALID: 'invalid123456',\n  SHORT: 'short',\n  EMPTY: '',\n} as const;\n\n// Validate TEST_PASSWORDS at module load to catch mutants\n(() => {\n  const passwords = Object.values(TEST_PASSWORDS);\n\n  if (passwords.length !== TEST_PASSWORDS_COUNT) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `TEST_PASSWORDS must contain exactly ${TEST_PASSWORDS_COUNT} passwords`\n    );\n  }\n\n  const uniquePasswords = [...new Set(passwords)];\n  if (uniquePasswords.length !== passwords.length) {\n    throw new Error('All TEST_PASSWORDS must be unique');\n  }\n\n  for (const [key, password] of Object.entries(TEST_PASSWORDS)) {\n    if (\n      password === null ||\n      password === undefined ||\n      typeof password !== 'string'\n    ) {\n      throw new Error(`TEST_PASSWORDS.${key} must be a string`);\n    }\n\n    // Allow empty passwords only for explicitly named test cases\n    if (password.length === 0 && !key.includes('EMPTY')) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `TEST_PASSWORDS.${key} cannot be empty (use EMPTY suffix for empty test passwords)`\n      );\n    }\n  }\n})();\n\n/**\n * Test API keys for testing API authentication\n */\nexport const TEST_API_KEYS = {\n  VALID: 'test-api-key-123456789',\n  INVALID: 'invalid-key',\n  EXPIRED: 'expired-key-123456',\n  EMPTY: '',\n} as const;\n\n/**\n * Test project data for comprehensive testing\n */\nexport const TEST_PROJECTS = {\n  BASIC: {\n    userId: 'test-user-1',\n    title: 'Test Project',\n    author: 'Test Author',\n    language: 'pt-BR' as const,\n    genre: 'Fiction',\n    status: 'draft' as const,\n    metadata: {},\n  },\n  EMPTY_AUTHOR: {\n    userId: 'test-user-2',\n    title: 'Project Without Author',\n    author: null,\n    language: 'en' as const,\n    genre: 'Non-Fiction',\n    status: 'processing' as const,\n    metadata: { tags: ['business'] },\n  },\n  COMPLETED: {\n    userId: 'test-user-3',\n    title: 'Completed Project',\n    author: 'Completion Author',\n    language: 'pt-BR' as const,\n    genre: 'Science Fiction',\n    status: 'completed' as [9.71s]\n","status":"Killed","testsCompleted":1,"killedBy":["0"],"location":{"end":{"column":4,"line":467},"start":{"column":73,"line":465}}}],"source":"/**\n * Custom Error Types\n *\n * Domain-specific error classes for better error handling\n */\n\nimport { HTTP_STATUS } from './constants/http-status.js';\n\n/**\n * Base application error\n */\nexport abstract class AppError extends Error {\n  abstract readonly code: string;\n  abstract readonly statusCode: number;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new application error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param cause - Original error that caused this error\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public override readonly cause?: Error\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AppError';\n\n    // Maintains proper stack trace for where our error was thrown (only available on V8)\n    if (Error.captureStackTrace) {\n      Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n  } {\n    return {\n      name: this.name,\n      code: this.code,\n      message: this.message,\n      statusCode: this.statusCode,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Validation errors\n */\nexport class ValidationError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new validation error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param field - Field that failed validation\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public readonly field?: string\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'ValidationError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    field?: string;\n  } {\n    const base = super.toJSON();\n    return this.field === undefined ? base : { ...base, field: this.field };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Authentication errors\n */\nexport class AuthenticationError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'AUTHENTICATION_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new authentication error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Authentication failed') {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AuthenticationError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Authorization errors\n */\nexport class AuthorizationError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'AUTHORIZATION_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.FORBIDDEN;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new authorization error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Access denied') {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AuthorizationError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Not found errors\n */\nexport class NotFoundError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'NOT_FOUND';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new not found error\n   * @param resource - Resource type\n   * @param identifier - Resource identifier\n   */\n  constructor(resource: string, identifier?: string) {\n    const message = identifier\n      ? `${resource} with identifier '${identifier}' not found`\n      : `${resource} not found`;\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'NotFoundError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    resource: string;\n  } {\n    return {\n      ...super.toJSON(),\n      resource: this.message.split(' with')[0] || this.message,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Conflict errors\n */\nexport class ConflictError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'CONFLICT';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new conflict error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   */\n  constructor(message: string) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'ConflictError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rate limit errors\n */\nexport class RateLimitError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new rate limit error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param retryAfter - Seconds to wait before retrying\n   */\n  constructor(\n    message = 'Rate limit exceeded',\n    public readonly retryAfter?: number\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'RateLimitError';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Converts error to JSON format\n   * @returns JSON representation of the error\n   */\n  public override toJSON(): {\n    name: string;\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    statusCode: number;\n    retryAfter?: number;\n  } {\n    const base = super.toJSON();\n    return this.retryAfter === undefined\n      ? base\n      : { ...base, retryAfter: this.retryAfter };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Internal server errors\n */\nexport class InternalServerError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new internal server error\n   * @param message - Error message\n   * @param cause - Original error\n   */\n  constructor(message = 'Internal server error', cause?: Error) {\n    super(message, cause);\n    this.name = 'InternalServerError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Database errors\n */\nexport class DatabaseError extends AppError {\n  readonly code = 'DATABASE_ERROR';\n  readonly statusCode = HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new database error\n   * @param message - *\n * Implements repository interfaces using the existing in-memory database\n */\n\nimport { randomBytes } from 'crypto';\nimport { injectable } from 'tsyringe';\nimport { CRYPTO } from '../constants/crypto.js';\nimport type { User, Project, ApiKey, Session } from '../types/entities';\n\n// Service interfaces\nexport interface PasswordHasher {\n  hash: (password: string) => string;\n}\n\nexport interface TokenGenerator {\n  generate: () => string;\n}\n\nexport interface ApiKeyGenerator {\n  generate: () => string;\n}\n\n// Request types\nexport interface CreateUserRequest {\n  email: string;\n  name: string;\n  password: string;\n  tier?: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';\n}\n\nexport interface CreateProjectRequest {\n  userId: string;\n  title: string;\n  author?: string;\n  language?: 'pt-BR' | 'en';\n  genre?: string;\n  status?: 'draft' | 'queued' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed';\n  metadata?: Record<"+"string, unknown>;\n}\n\nexport interface CreateApiKeyRequest {\n  userId: string;\n  name: string;\n  scopes: string[];\n}\n\n// Repository interfaces\nexport interface UserRepository {\n  createUser: (userData: CreateUserRequest) => Promise<"+"User>;\n  findByEmail: (email: string) => Promise<"+"User | null>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"User | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\nexport interface ProjectRepository {\n  createProject: (data: CreateProjectRequest) => Promise<"+"Project>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"Project | null>;\n  findByUserId: (userId: string) => Promise<"+"Project[]>;\n  update: (id: string, data: Partial<"+"Project>) => Promise<"+"Project | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\nexport interface ApiKeyRepository {\n  createApiKey: (data: CreateApiKeyRequest) => Promise<"+"ApiKey>;\n  findById: (id: string) => Promise<"+"ApiKey | null>;\n  findByKey: (key: string) => Promise<"+"ApiKey | null>;\n  delete: (id: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\nexport interface SessionRepository {\n  createSession: (userId: string) => Promise<"+"string>;\n  findByToken: (token: string) => Promise<"+"Session | null>;\n  delete: (token: string) => Promise<"+"boolean>;\n}\n\n/**\n * In-memory database repository implementation\n */\n@injectable()\nexport class DatabaseRepository {\n  private users: Map<"+"string, User> = new Map();\n  private projects: Map<"+"string, Project> = new Map();\n  private apiKeys: Map<"+"string, ApiKey> = new Map();\n  private sessions: Map<"+"string, Session> = new Map();\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a new DatabaseRepository instance\n   * @param passwordHasher - Service for hashing passwords\n   * @param tokenGenerator - Service for generating tokens\n   * @param apiKeyGenerator - Service for generating API keys\n   */\n  constructor(\n    private passwordHasher: PasswordHasher,\n    private tokenGenerator: TokenGenerator,\n    private apiKeyGenerator: ApiKeyGenerator\n  ) {}\n\n  // Helper method to generate IDs\n  /**\n   * Generates a unique identifier using random bytes\n   * @returns Generated ID as hexadecimal string\n   */\n  private generateId(): string {\n    return randomBytes(CRYPTO.ID_BYTES).toString('hex');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Gets the current timestamp in ISO format\n   * @returns Current timestamp as ISO string\n   */\n  private getCurrentTimestamp(): string {\n    return new Date().toISOString();\n  }\n\n  // UserRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new user in the database\n   * @param userData - User data to create\n   * @returns Created user object\n   */\n  async createUser(userData: CreateUserRequest): Promise<"+"User> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const user: User = {\n      id,\n      email: userData.email,\n      name: userData.name,\n      passwordHash: this.passwordHasher.hash(userData.password),\n      tier: userData.tier || 'free',\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    this.users.set(id, user);\n    return user;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a user by email address\n   * @param email - Email address to search for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return (\n      Array.from(this.users.values()).find((user) => user.email === email) ||\n      null\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a user by ID\n   * @param id - User ID to search for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findUserById(id: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return this.users.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a user by ID\n   * @param id - User ID to delete\n   * @returns True if user was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteUser(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.users.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // ProjectRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new project in the database\n   * @param data - Project data to create\n   * @returns Created project object\n   */\n  async createProject(data: CreateProjectRequest): Promise<"+"Project> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const project: Project = {\n      id,\n      userId: data.userId,\n      title: data.title,\n      author: data.author || null,\n      language: data.language || 'pt-BR',\n      genre: data.genre || null,\n      status: data.status || 'draft',\n      metadata: data.metadata || {},\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    this.projects.set(id, project);\n    return project;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a project by ID\n   * @param id - Project ID to search for\n   * @returns Project object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findProjectById(id: string): Promise<"+"Project | null> {\n    return this.projects.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds all projects for a specific user\n   * @param userId - User ID to search projects for\n   * @returns Array of projects belonging to the user\n   */\n  async findProjectsByUserId(userId: string): Promise<"+"Project[]> {\n    return Array.from(this.projects.values()).filter(\n      (project) => project.userId === userId\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Updates a project with new data\n   * @param id - Project ID to update\n   * @param data - Partial project data to update\n   * @returns Updated project object or null if not found\n   */\n  async updateProject(\n    id: string,\n    data: Partial<"+"Project>\n  ): Promise<"+"Project | null> {\n    const project = this.projects.get(id);\n    if (!project) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    const updated: Project = {\n      ...project,\n      ...data,\n      updatedAt: this.getCurrentTimestamp(),\n    };\n    this.projects.set(id, updated);\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a project by ID\n   * @param id - Project ID to delete\n   * @returns True if project was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteProject(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.projects.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // ApiKeyRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new API key in the database\n   * @param data - API key data to create\n   * @returns Created API key object\n   */\n  async createApiKey(data: CreateApiKeyRequest): Promise<"+"ApiKey> {\n    const id = this.generateId();\n    const key = this.apiKeyGenerator.generate();\n    const now = this.getCurrentTimestamp();\n    const apiKey: ApiKey = {\n      id,\n      userId: data.userId,\n      key,\n      name: data.name,\n      scopes: data.scopes,\n      createdAt: now,\n      lastUsedAt: null,\n    };\n    this.apiKeys.set(id, apiKey);\n    return apiKey;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds an API key by ID\n   * @param id - API key ID to search for\n   * @returns API key object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findApiKeyById(id: string): Promise<"+"ApiKey | null> {\n    return this.apiKeys.get(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds an API key by the actual key value\n   * @param key - API key value to search for\n   * @returns API key object or null if not found\n   */\n  async findApiKeyByKey(key: string): Promise<"+"ApiKey | null> {\n    return (\n      Array.from(this.apiKeys.values()).find((ak) => ak.key === key) || null\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes an API key by ID\n   * @param id - API key ID to delete\n   * @returns True if API key was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteApiKey(id: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.apiKeys.delete(id);\n  }\n\n  // SessionRepository implementation\n  /**\n   * Creates a new session for a user\n   * @param userId - User ID to create session for\n   * @returns Generated session token\n   */\n  async createSession(userId: string): Promise<"+"string> {\n    const token = this.tokenGenerator.generate();\n    const expiresAt = new Date(\n      Date.now() + CRYPTO.SESSION_DURATION_MS\n    ).toISOString(); // 24 hours\n    this.sessions.set(token, { userId, token, expiresAt });\n    return token;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds a session by token\n   * @param token - Session token to search for\n   * @returns Session object or null if not found or expired\n   */\n  async findSessionByToken(token: string): Promise<"+"Session | null> {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(token);\n    if (!session) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    // Check expiration\n    if (new Date(session.expiresAt) <"+" new Date()) {\n      this.sessions.delete(token);\n      return null;\n    }\n    return session;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Deletes a session by token\n   * @param token - Session token to delete\n   * @returns True if session was deleted, false otherwise\n   */\n  async deleteSession(token: string): Promise<"+"boolean> {\n    return this.sessions.delete(token);\n  }\n\n  // Additional convenience methods for testing\n  /**\n   * Gets a user by session token\n   * @param token - Session token to find user for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async getUserByToken(token: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    const session = await this.findSessionByToken(token);\n    if (!session) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return this.findUserById(session.userId);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Gets a user by API key\n   * @param apiKey - API key to find user for\n   * @returns User object or null if not found\n   */\n  async getUserByApiKey(apiKey: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    const key = await this.findApiKeyByKey(apiKey);\n    if (!key) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return this.findUserById(key.userId);\n  }\n\n  // Clear all data (for testing)\n  /**\n   * Clears all data from all repositories\n   */\n  clear(): void {\n    this.users.clear();\n    this.projects.clear();\n    this.apiKeys.clear();\n    this.sessions.clear();\n  }\n}\n"},"src/repositories/in-memory-api-key-repository.ts":{"language":"typescript","mutants":[{"id":"347","mutatorName":"BlockStatement","replacement":"{}","statusReason":"bun test v1.3.0  }\n\n  /**\n   * Finds an API key by its key value\n   * @param key - The API key value to search for\n   * @returns Promise<"+"ApiKey | null> - The found API key or null\n   */\n  async *\n   * @param id\n   */\n  async findById(id: string): Promise<"+"User | null> {\n    return this.database.getUserById(id) || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   *\n   * @param email\n   */\n  async
